rule: Every table row published on the site carries one of these source ids. A value that cannot be traced to one of these URLs is left blank and flagged - it is never inferred.

S1.title: NBA.com Stats - Teams Advanced (2026-27 Regular Season, season to date)
S1.used_for: Team efficiency ratings (OffRtg, DefRtg, NetRtg, Pace, eFG%, TS%, TOV%, REB%, PIE) and won-lost records, through the games of 2026-11-12.

S2.title: NBA.com Stats - Teams Advanced, date range 10/20/2026 to 11/05/2026
S2.used_for: Training-window team ratings for the out-of-sample test (no game after 2026-11-05 contributes to these numbers).

S3_2026-11-06.title: NBA.com Games & Scores - November 6, 2026
S3_2026-11-06.used_for: Final scores (out-of-sample test games); also rest flags for 2026-11-07.

S3_2026-11-07.title: NBA.com Games & Scores - November 7, 2026
S3_2026-11-07.used_for: Final scores (out-of-sample test games); also rest flags for 2026-11-08. Includes the NBA Mexico City Game (DEN vs IND) played at a neutral site.

S3_2026-11-12.used_for: Final scores (out-of-sample test games); also rest flags for 2026-11-13.

S4.title: NBA.com Schedule
S4.used_for: Upcoming slate: dates, tip times (ET), venues, game ids, Emirates NBA Cup group labels.

S5.title: NBA Injury Report: 2026-27 Season (index of every published edition)
S5.used_for: Index of the league's official injury report PDFs and the reporting deadlines that govern them.

S6.title: NBA Official Injury Report, 11/13/26 07:30 PM ET edition (PDF)
S6.used_for: Every injury status column on the site: player, team, status and reason, and the 11/14 'NOT YET SUBMITTED' rows.

S7.title: NBA.com Stats - Players Traditional (2026-27 Regular Season)
S7.used_for: Per-game player averages (page 1 of 10 = top 50 scorers). Player-prop baselines only; no player outside this page is modelled.

S9.title: NBA.com Standings
S9.used_for: CONSULTED BUT NOT USABLE: the standings table is rendered client-side and does not appear in the page source available to a plain HTTP fetch (only the tie-break procedure text is present). Won-lost records were therefore taken from S1 and the S8 game pages instead. See Flagged for Review F1.
